expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: This is the full north in a week: the flooded fields at Tam Coc, the terraces at Sa Pa and a night on the bay.
expert.tip: The Ninh Binh day is long. Eat a proper breakfast, and keep small notes for the woman rowing your boat.

summary: A week covering the whole north: two nights in Hanoi with a day among the rowing boats and rice fields of Ninh Binh, a night at Sa Pa for Cat Cat village and the Fansipan cable car, then an overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave before a last night in the city.
included: Included: 6 nights with breakfast and dinner at the hotels, one of them on a cruise boat with lunch and dinner; private transfers throughout; a Ninh Binh day tour; a private cycle ride to Bich Dong; a half day walk to Cat Cat village; the Fansipan mountain tour with the cable car; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches other than on the cruise; travel insurance; personal expenses.
